facts.fact: The housing minister's site reports a land digitisation protocol was signed with SNEDAI on 14 September 2026 for a system centralising cadastral data, with a pilot envisaged in the Estuaire, and works on the first lots were being accelerated in October 2026.

systems.owner: Ministère du Logement, de l'Habitat, de l'Urbanisme et du Cadastre
